purpose: Hierarchical building blocks: seeds → derived → T1/T2/T3 → S → core+extension domain interfaces (full atlas expansion) → residual law.

nodes.name: observer_modulated_base
nodes.role: Dimensional base + growth + optional observer branch

nodes.name: linear_modulation
nodes.role: Scale / amplitude / trend (defaults 1,1,0 on domain routes)

nodes.name: valve_acoustic_phase
nodes.role: POOF/SUCTION valves, chaos(D-25), acoustic bleed — fluid dynamics heart

simulation_hooks.evaluate_extension: compute_scalar(ScalarInput(D_eff, hits, delta_psi, observed from extension_domains_manifest))
simulation_hooks.residual: c = m*(1+|S|*f); f from DOMAIN_FACTORS[core] or nearest-core inheritance
simulation_hooks.string_between_domains: shared seeds + T1/T2/T3; differ by interface tuple; extensions fold to cores
simulation_hooks.hierarchy_rule: Lower D_eff = micro building blocks; higher D_eff folds toward ceiling 25. Full expansion (~400 domains) uses same formula as the 35 cores.
